headline: Nasdaq remains under pressure as yields and oil stay elevated; Tail moves modestly above threshold
body: The Nasdaq was about 0.8% lower at 11:30 ET after first-hour weakness, with the 10-year Treasury yield near 4.70% and Brent above $93. Negative breadth and weak megacap participation add alignment, while semiconductors are more mixed and detailed NQ pullback structure remains insufficiently verified.
